# LunaPic

> > LunaPic is a free online photo editor offering filters, effects, AI features, and drawing tools for image editing and creation.

LunaPic provides a comprehensive suite of web-based image editing tools accessible without installation. The platform integrates AI-powered features like Super Resolution and Ultra Resolution alongside traditional photo editing capabilities, background removal, and image conversion utilities.

## Key Topics

- free online photo editor
- photo editing
- image filters and effects
- AI Super Resolution
- AI Ultra Resolution
- drawing and painting tools
- background removal
- image conversion
- image manipulation
- web-based editing
- filter effects
- creative tools
- QR code generation

## Core Features

- [LunaPic Home](https://www2.lunapic.com/): Main entry point to LunaPic's free online photo editor with access to all editing, filtering, AI, and drawing tools.
